# Clone Ticket FreshDesk marketplace app to clone a ticket https://www.freshworks.com/apps/freshdesk/clone_ticket_1 ## Setup 1. Install nvm: `brew install nvm`. Verify installation: `nvm --version` 2. Install node: `nvm install 18.16.0`. Verify installation: `node --version` 3. Install xcode: `xcode-select --install`. Verify installation: `xcode-select -p` 4. Install fdk: `npm install https://cdn.freshdev.io/fdk/latest.tgz -g`. Verify installation: `fdk version` 5. Install packages: `npm install` 6. Setup authentication - Execute the command: `npx playwright codegen --save-storage=auth.json` - Login to the following accounts - https://symphony-us.freshdesk.com/support/login - https://growth-account.freshdesk.com/support/login - Close the browser - Set the API key of those accounts in environment variables: - `export SYMPHONY_ACCOUNT_API_KEY=<api-key>` - `export BLOSSOM_ACCOUNT_API_KEY=<api-key>` 7. Start the server: `fdk run` ## Development 1. Go to the [installation page](http://localhost:10001/custom_configs) 2. # Bulk Ticket Manager Light ## Description * Full page front-end Freshdesk app for bulk [updating](https://developer.freshdesk.com/api/#bulk_update_tickets) or [deleting](https://developer.freshdesk.com/api/#delete_a_ticket) existing tickets using the Freshdesk Bulk API methods. * The tickets ids are provided with a XLS(X)/CSV file that should contain ticket ids only in 1 single column. Sample is available in the app. * The Freshdesk ticket fields and their values are configured in the UI. ## Instructions * Bundle the app using `npm run build`. * Run the app locally using `npm run start`. ### Installation Page * [Dynamic installation parameters](https://developer.freshdesk.com/v2/docs/installation-parameters/#dynamic_install_page) for collecting a list of Roles and Groups. * The access to the app can be limited either by email, by role or by group. * When the full page app is opened, an expiring record is created in the database every 5 seconds. This makes it possible to use the app in 1 tab/browser by 1 agent only. ## Other * [Asana task](https://app.asana.com/0/search/1201551567661029/1200058217125771) * [Marketplace submission Google
